statuses.Supported: Parsed into typed ZigCSS structure and emitted deterministically.
statuses.Preserved: Accepted and emitted from lossless component values without a complete typed semantic model.
statuses.Rejected: Rejected with a structured diagnostic and no CSS output.

features.syntax: Unicode identifiers, CSS escapes, strings, URLs, numbers, dimensions, and percentages
features.notes: Original byte spans are retained while decoded names remain available.

features.syntax: Nested functions and (), [], {} component blocks
features.notes: Top-level declaration and rule boundaries never split nested delimiters.

features.syntax: Type, universal, class, ID, compound, and selector-list syntax
features.notes: Compound adjacency is structurally distinct from descendant combinators.

features.syntax: Descendant, child (>), next-sibling (+), and subsequent-sibling (~) combinators
features.notes: Pretty and minified modes retain the same combinator structure.

features.syntax: Namespace statements and namespace-qualified type, universal, and attribute selectors
features.notes: Empty, wildcard, and named selector namespace states are distinct.

features.syntax: Attribute matchers, quoted or identifier values, namespaces, and i/s flags
features.notes: Operator, value spelling, quoting, namespace, and case metadata are retained.

features.syntax: :is(), :where(), :not(), :has(), pseudo-classes, and pseudo-elements
features.notes: :is() and :where() use forgiving selector lists; strict forms diagnose invalid arguments.

features.syntax: Explicit &, implicit parent references, leading combinators, and nested group rules
features.notes: Nesting is represented directly and is not expanded into flattened selectors.

features.syntax: Column combinator (||)
features.notes: Representable internally but excluded from the selected stable Selectors Level 4 grammar.

features.syntax: Ordered duplicate declarations, fallback values, and !important
features.notes: No property map or early cascade evaluation can remove authored fallback order.

features.syntax: Custom property names and arbitrary nested component values
features.notes: Case-sensitive identities, cascade scopes, fallbacks, cycles, empty values, and token boundaries are retained without static substitution.

features.syntax: Property-specific values and future value functions
features.notes: Values are lossless component trees; broad property-specific semantic validation is not yet claimed.

features.syntax: @media, @supports, and named or anonymous @container rules
features.notes: Typed preludes compose with ordered recursive rule blocks.

features.syntax: @layer statements, names, and blocks
features.notes: Statement and block forms remain distinct.

features.syntax: Declaration-backed @property and @font-face blocks
features.notes: Rule-specific prelude requirements and declaration blocks are validated.

features.syntax: @keyframes names, from/to, percentage selectors, and declaration blocks
features.notes: Frame and declaration order are retained.

features.syntax: @page selectors, declarations, and margin at-rules
features.notes: Mixed page items retain their authored ordering.

features.syntax: Semicolon forms such as @charset, @import, and @namespace
features.notes: Names and preludes are lossless; import fetching and dependency analysis are out of scope.

features.syntax: Unknown or future at-rules and property values
features.notes: Nested component structure and whitespace-token presence are retained without invented semantics.

features.syntax: Declaration candidates missing a top-level colon
features.notes: The CLI reports a filename, location, and diagnostic code and emits no partial CSS.
